ctgov.note: Most are completed/withdrawn legacy ThermoDox studies under prior name (Celsion). Active drug trials are IMNN-001 (OVATION 2 P1/2 active not recruiting; OVATION 3 P3 recruiting; P2 with bevacizumab recruiting).

pipeline.modality: TheraPlas DNA-based IL-12 immunotherapy (IL-12 plasmid formulated with PEG-PEI-cholesterol lipopolymer)

indications.indication: Newly diagnosed advanced epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer (1L, with NACT)
indications.trial_design: Phase 3 randomized trial of IMNN-001 administered IP with standard neoadjuvant chemotherapy (carboplatin + paclitaxel) and adjuvant chemotherapy in newly diagnosed advanced EOC, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer; includes PARP inhibitor maintenance (olaparib/niraparib)
key_milestones: OVATION 2 reported overall survival benefit of 11 months over standard of care

indications.indication: Advanced ovarian cancer with bevacizumab (Phase 2 SLL evaluation)
indications.trial_design: Open-label Phase 1/2 of IMNN-001 in combination with bevacizumab and standard NACT (paclitaxel + carboplatin) in newly diagnosed advanced ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer; second-look laparoscopy endpoint
Open-label Phase 1/2 randomized study of IMNN-001 IP with neoadjuvant carboplatin + paclitaxel in newly diagnosed advanced EOC

excluded_preclinical: IMNN-201 (FixPlas, Trp2 TAA melanoma vaccine) - preclinical
excluded_legacy_terminated: ThermoDox (lyso-thermosensitive liposomal doxorubicin) - all Phase 1/2/3 studies completed/terminated/withdrawn (NCT00617981, NCT02112656, NCT01464593, NCT01640847, NCT02850419, NCT00441376, NCT04852367, NCT02181075, NCT00826085, NCT00061867, NCT00036998, NCT00036985)
IMNN-101 (PlaCCine SARS-CoV-2 vaccine) Phase 1 NCT06283459 - completed 2025-03-07; not currently advancing in active trial
